idea: The derivative at a point is the slope of the tangent there: the value the slopes of secant lines approach as their second point slides in.

parameters.name: x0
parameters.why: Covers both turning points of the curve and the slopes between them.

parameters.name: h
parameters.why: From a wide secant down to almost the tangent; at zero the two points coincide and there is no secant.

moves: Nothing moves on its own; the secant, the tangent and the rise-over-run triangle follow the point and the gap, and both points can be dragged.
steps: Secant slope is rise over run
Shrink h: the secant becomes the tangent
The derivative is the tangent's slope
Zero slope where the curve turns
